primary_source.title: Data Scale, Not Latency, Shapes Cross-Lingual Encoder Transfer in Streaming ASR

observations.model_family: 0.6B cache-aware FastConformer RNN-T streaming ASR trained/evaluated with NeMo

int4_encoder_quantization.condition: 4-bit weight-only encoder quantization at matched 560 ms tier

observations.nemotron_relationship: The study uses the English Nemotron streaming encoder as one initialization and separately compares a 5000h Spanish continuation with contemporaneous Nemotron-3.5-ASR-Streaming-0.6B; it is not a benchmark of the exact released German Nemotron 3.5 checkpoint used by Frankenstein.

bounded_inference: Quantization and latency should be measured as separate benchmark axes for the target Nemotron candidate. The proxy result is strong enough to justify an optional exact-identity INT4 challenger after the official source-pinned Q8 baseline, but it cannot predict the released checkpoint's German WER, latency or memory result.
benchmark_delta: Keep official source-pinned Q8 as the first target-runtime baseline.
Measure right-context tiers independently of quantization instead of collapsing both into one deployment variant.
If an INT4 artifact can be deterministically derived, record converter/runtime/build identity and exact output hash before load.
Compare Q8 vs INT4 on identical German audio and report quality, partial stability, latency and resident memory separately.
Do not promote proxy-paper numbers as Nemotron runtime credit.

current_execution_gate.reason: Avoid queue fan-out while the established self-hosted runner/control-plane admission gate remains unresolved.
